column6: A quick and carefree theme that makes use of many airy synths and shares some of its instruments with the Overworld Day theme. Contains a motif of Underground.
It has a slower and calmer feeling.
An ambient track which subtly features "psychedelic" sounds for a sci-fi feeling and gradually grows to a heroic sound.
Somewhat heroic-sounding, and features chanting as well as ample amounts of electric guitar.
Resembles The Towers track but has more chanting and feels even more dramatic, as is appropriate with the Moon Lord appearing after the Lunar Events.
Ethereal, surreal, and yet calming track that bears a similarity to the Space tracks, fitting for the location the track plays in.
